description: This NYC Open Data table lists all facade compliance filings submitted in DOB NOW, the Department of Buildings system for the Facade Inspection Safety Program, in which a qualified exterior wall inspector files a report on a building's facade for each inspection cycle. Its 40 fields include filing and control numbers, filing type, cycle, building identification number, address, borough, block and lot, submission and filing dates, current and prior filing status, the qualified exterior wall inspector's details, owner details, field inspection and sign-off dates, late filing, failure to file and failure to correct penalties, comments, and exterior wall types and materials. It has been public since September 2016 and is updated every weekday. Coverage: buildings in New York City subject to facade inspection. Access: CSV, JSON and Socrata API from NYC Open Data. Licence: NYC Open Data terms; free. Caveats: statuses are administrative classifications from inspectors' reports, and the table was read here from its metadata, not the programme rules page, which returned 404. Simulation uses are facade condition and ageing indicators, falling debris risk and prioritising inspections. Related records: NYC DOB violations and PLUTO.
